info.title: PressPilot API
info.description: Secure REST API + a native MCP (Model Context Protocol) endpoint so an AI agent — Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Cursor, or the plugin's own copilot driving Anthropic/OpenAI/OpenRouter/AgentRouter — can build and manage a WordPress site: native Gutenberg blocks or Elementor (Pro), migrate Elementor → Gutenberg in place, and manage menus, plugins, block-theme (FSE) templates, global styles/CSS, themes, site options and plugin configuration. Each route belongs to a capability scope the admin can toggle on the Permissions screen (a disabled scope returns 403 pp_scope_disabled).

tags.name: Config
tags.description: Configuration assistant: read/write options, meta & terms; snapshots/restore; discovery; REST proxy; plugin adapters; custom DB tables; admin-ajax; opt-in code exec. Scope: config.

tags.name: MCP
tags.description: Model Context Protocol server (Streamable HTTP, JSON-RPC 2.0). The direct connection for MCP-speaking agents: tools, resources and prompts, gated by the same capability scopes. Dual-era — both the legacy initialize handshake and the modern stateless server/discover shape are answered.

The direct agent connection. Send one JSON-RPC request per POST with `Accept: application/json, text/event-stream`. Supported methods: `initialize`, `server/discover`, `ping`, `tools/list`, `tools/call`, `resources/list`, `resources/read`, `resources/templates/list`, `prompts/list`, `prompts/get`. Notifications are answered with 202 and no body; GET and DELETE return 405 (this server is stateless and opens no standalone stream). Auth is the same API key as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`; `?key=` is accepted when the admin has enabled it. Tools whose capability scope is disabled are omitted from `tools/list` entirely.

innerHTML.description: Saved HTML for this block (leaf/simple blocks).

innerContentOpen.description: Wrapper opening markup for a container block; children serialize between open/close. e.g. '<div class="wp-block-group">'.

append.description: On update: append items instead of replacing.

slug.description: e.g. header, footer, index, single, archive.

parent.description: Parent page ID. Nests the page so its URL becomes /{parent-slug}/{slug}/ — e.g. a language subdirectory /fa/faq/.

content.description: Raw block markup / HTML for post_content (trusted by default).

blocks.description: Structured Gutenberg block tree, serialized server-side to block markup. Takes priority over 'content'.

builder.description: 'gutenberg' (or 'block') detaches the post from Elementor before writing — in-place migration.

clear_elementor.description: Remove all Elementor meta and reset the page template (same effect as builder=gutenberg).

allow_unfiltered_html.description: Default true (API-key gated trusted write; <style>/SVG survive). Set false to force classic KSES filtering.
